theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (Φ : Eucl n → Eucl P) (Ω : Set (Eucl n)) (A : Set (Eucl P)) (h : Eucl P → ℝ) (L : ℝ≥0) (G : Eucl P → Eucl P), IsOpen Ω → ContDiff ℝ 1 Φ → (∃ K : ℝ≥0, LipschitzOnWith K Φ Ω) → (∃ κ : ℝ, 0 < κ ∧ ∀ w ∈ Ω, ∀ w' ∈ Ω, κ * ‖w - w'‖ ≤ ‖Φ w - Φ w'‖) → NullMeasurableSet A (μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl P)) → LipschitzWith L h → (∀ᵐ x ∂((μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl P)).restrict A), ∀ w ∈ Ω, Φ w = x → ∀ u ∈ LinearMap.range (fderiv ℝ Φ w).toLinearMap, HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => h (x + s • u)) (inner ℝ (G x) u) 0) → ∀ᵐ w ∂((volume : Measure (Eucl n)).restrict (Ω ∩ Φ ⁻¹' A)), HasFDerivAt (h ∘ Φ) ((innerSL ℝ (G (Φ w))).comp (fderiv ℝ Φ w)) w
